_meta.title: Second EU Minorities and Discrimination Survey (EU-MIDIS II, 2016)
_meta.measures: Share of respondents from each surveyed minority group who felt discriminated against because of ethnic or immigrant background in the 12 months before the survey, in at least one area of daily life. Each country lists the groups surveyed there (by_group). 'value' is the highest group figure in that country; 'being_black_2016' adds the 12-month and 5-year rates for people of African descent from 'Being Black in the EU' (2018).
_meta.source: European Union Agency for Fundamental Rights (FRA)
_meta.licence: © European Union Agency for Fundamental Rights. 'Reproduction is authorised provided the source is acknowledged.' (report imprint); EU reuse policy, Commission Decision 2011/833/EU (data.europa.eu lists FRA datasets under 'European Commission reuse notice').
_meta.citation: FRA (2017), Second European Union Minorities and Discrimination Survey - Main results; FRA (2018), Being Black in the EU.
figures: Being Black in the EU Fig 21 p.41
_meta.notes: Values in brackets in the source (small samples) are flagged small_sample_flag=true. Group codes: SSAFR Sub-Saharan Africa, TUR Turkey, NOAFR North Africa, (S)ASIA South Asia and Asia, RIMGR recent immigrants, ROMA Roma, RUSMIN Russian minority.
_meta.how_values_were_read: FRA publishes these as charts. Values are the printed data labels on each chart, read by OCR and confirmed against the bar's length on the chart's own axis. Where a printed label was missing in OCR, the bar length was used and rounded ('_read': 'bar'). '_read': 'text' means the PDF had the number as text.
